quote: Insanity is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results.
author: Albert Einstein

quote: I loved that pigeon as a man loves a woman, and she loved me. As long as I had her, there was a purpose to my life.
author: Nikola Tesla

quote: If you're trying to show off for people at the top, forget it. They will look down on you anyhow. And if you're trying to show off for people at the bottom, forget it. They will only envy you. Status will get you nowhere. Only an open heart will allow you to float equally between everyone.
author: Mitch Albom, Tuesdays with Morrie: An Old Man, a Young Man, and Life's Greatest Lesson

quote: What you are afraid of is never as bad as what you imagine. The fear you let build up in your mind is worse than the situation that actually exists.
author: Spencer Johnson, Who Moved My Cheese?
